name: flowzone
description: Run secure FlowZone capabilities for Markdown review, executive dashboards, and evidence-backed code workflow maps.

interface.shortDescription: Markdown review, dashboards, and code workflow maps.
interface.longDescription: Runs statically registered FlowZone capabilities through one local MCP server and one model-visible data router. Includes Markdown Review for line-anchored document feedback, Dyna for persistent executive priority queues and safe cross-task work synchronization, and CallFlow for bounded evidence-backed code workflow maps.
defaultPrompt: Use $flowzone:markdown-review to review this Markdown file.
Use $flowzone:dyna to open my executive dashboard and keep its work items synchronized.
Use $flowzone:callflow to map this entry point to its sink with verified evidence.
